_comment: Taking the splinter out of the open case (Act 3, D118). Same shape as
scene_box.json and for the same reason: a prop cannot carry an interaction of its
own here, so the prompt is an attachToWorld scnChoiceNode hung on #ac_box_origin -
It is the SECOND prompt on that one marker. scene_box.json opens the case and sets
ashcache_box_opened; between the two the glue draws the opened case with the
splinter visible in it, and this prompt is what makes the player reach in and take
it. The graph's take_chip node blocks on this scene inside guard_splinter's True
branch, so the grant it releases (give_splinter) keeps its re-entry guard: a
phase_revision bump re-walks the graph, finds ashcache_splinter_given already 1,
and never shows this prompt again.
No lines, no actors, no tier - the same reasons as the box scene.

nodes._attachToWorld: Same offset and range as the box hub: #ac_box_origin sits on the case's base at the bench top, and the splinter lies inside the open lid, so 0.2 m up still puts the prompt on the object being reached for.
